imgDesc.text: A rather odd ice statue found inside one of the rooms at the princess of the Snegurochka's mountain residence. The light sources around it create shadows on the paintings on the opposite walls. Remove and recreate the Prime Ice statue to align its position, and thus its shadow, with the images in every painting in the room...
